questions.question: Many students choose online courses _____ they offer greater flexibility.
questions.explanation_cn: 前后是因果关系，因此使用 because。
questions.explanation_en: The second clause gives the reason, so 'because' is correct.

questions.question: _____ the weather was terrible, the flight departed on time.
questions.explanation_cn: 前后表示转折，应使用 Although。
questions.explanation_en: The sentence expresses contrast, so 'Although' is correct.

questions.question: You won't improve your English _____ you practise regularly.
The company aims to reduce costs _____ improve customer satisfaction.
questions.explanation_cn: 两个并列目标，应使用 and。

questions.question: The report was well written; _____, it lacked sufficient evidence.
questions.explanation_cn: 前后表示转折，因此使用 however。

questions.question: The course focuses on developing students' ability to analyse, evaluate, and _____.
questions.explanation_cn: analyse、evaluate 都是动词，因此第三项也必须保持动词形式，符合平行结构。
questions.explanation_en: Items in a series should have the same grammatical form. Here, all three should be verbs.

questions.question: The university not only provides modern facilities _____ offers excellent academic support.
questions.explanation_en: Use the correlative conjunction 'not only...but also...'.

questions.question: Students can choose _____ online learning _____ face-to-face classes.
questions.explanation_cn: 表示二选一，应使用 either...or...。

questions.question: The research was rejected _____ its innovative methodology.
questions.explanation_cn: despite 后接名词或名词短语；although 后接完整句子。
questions.explanation_en: 'Despite' is followed by a noun phrase, whereas 'although' introduces a clause.

questions.question: The professor encouraged students to think critically rather than _____ information.
questions.explanation_cn: rather than 前后应保持平行结构。前面是 think，后面也应使用动词原形 memorise。
questions.explanation_en: Maintain parallel structure. After 'rather than', use the same grammatical form as the previous verb.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: Not only did she pass the exam, but she also received a scholarship.
Despite the heavy rain, the match continued.
Although the heavy rain, the match continued.
The course aims to develop students' ability to analyse, evaluate, and solve problems.

questions.explanation_cn: A：not only 位于句首时需要部分倒装。B：despite 后接名词短语。C：错误，although 后必须接完整句子。D：analyse、evaluate、solve 保持平行结构，是 IELTS/PTE 写作中的高频考点。
questions.explanation_en: A correctly uses inversion after 'Not only'. B correctly uses 'despite' with a noun phrase. C is incorrect because 'although' must be followed by a clause. D correctly maintains parallel structure.
